pages.text: Awakened Supremium is a high level crafting material used to create upgraded versions of many of your Supremium items. $(br2)Awakened Supremium is $(bold)usually$() created by infusing $(l:elemental/cognizant_dust)Cognizant Dust$() with a Supremium Block using an $(l:elemental/awakening_altar)Awakening Altar$().
